mapper.insert: insert into interviews (id, user_id, opportunity_id, role, questions, answers, created_at) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{opportunityId}, #{role}, #{questions,typeHandler=com.jobready.common.json.InterviewQuestionListTypeHandler}, #{answers,typeHandler=com.jobready.common.json.InterviewAnswerListTypeHandler}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: update interviews set answers = #{answers,typeHandler=com.jobready.common.json.InterviewAnswerListTypeHandler} where id = #{id}
